context: REPLAB proposes repeatable low-cost-arm manipulation tests: calibrate each cell by aligning camera views, compensate control noise by commanding a 5×5 floor grid and fitting target \(p_i\) to achieved \(q_i\), then randomly sample clustered-object grasps. Random collection achieved ~21% success, with fewer than two interventions/day; labels used 5,000 manual examples and a classifier reaching 99.6%.
